title: docs(skills): drop the four retired CLI rows from project-setup.md's command table (objectui#11511)
body:
Fixes #11511
Clause-②: no

## What changed

The CLI table under the `## CLI commands` heading of `skills/objectui/guides/project-setup.md` drops four rows. Their commands were retired under objectui#11500 (PR #11508, landed as `37268aae9`, an ancestor of this branch's base), and the built CLI now refuses each as an unknown command, exits 1 and writes nothing, pinned by the `cli-bin.test.ts` describe block named "the retired create, lint, test and studio commands are refused". The dropped rows, quoted:

- `| \`objectui studio\` | Visual UI editor |`
- `| \`objectui lint\` | Lint generated app code (ESLint) |`
- `| \`objectui test\` | Run app tests (Vitest) |`
- `| \`objectui create plugin\` | Scaffold a new plugin |`

One prose line follows the table, saying what `content/docs/utilities/cli.mdx` already teaches: "A plugin package is scaffolded by its own initializer, `npm create @object-ui/plugin NAME`, not by the CLI." (`NAME` is an uppercase placeholder word on purpose: GitHub strips tag-shaped fragments from a body, so no angle-bracket placeholder is written anywhere in this PR.)

`lint` / `test` get no replacement row: the project's own ESLint / Vitest are not this CLI's business, and the card asks for none. `studio` has no published replacement.

`.changeset/11511-project-setup-retired-cli-rows.md`, an empty-frontmatter changeset, declares the docs-only change — this repository's one-declaration form; no package is released.

## Readings

**Grep pin (the card's own pin, carried in this PR).** The command, in the form printed here: `git grep "objectui studio\|objectui lint\|objectui test\|create plugin" origin/main -- skills/objectui/`

- On the base `83e3f83`: 4 hits, every one of them in the CLI table of `project-setup.md`, and every one of them a row quoted above. No other guide under `skills/objectui/` names any of the four.
- On this branch's head `5936490`: 0 hits (`git grep` exits 1).

**The `objectui generate` row stays.** `packages/cli/src/cli.ts` still declares `.command('generate')` with `plugin` among its argument's types, and `packages/cli/src/commands/generate.ts` still dispatches `case 'plugin'` to `generatePlugin`, so the row's `(\`object\`, \`page\`, \`plugin\`)` is true on the base and is not touched. The commands the table now lists — `init`, `dev` (with `serve`, which `cli.ts` describes as its alias), `build`, `start`, `validate`, `check`, `generate`, `doctor`, `analyze` — are exactly the `.command(...)` set `cli.ts` declares.

**Governed surface.** `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test skills/objectui/guides/project-setup.md .changeset/11511-project-setup-retired-cli-rows.md` answers `⛔ GOVERNED — 1 of 2 path(s) are on a governed surface: skills/** x1 — the published skills catalog`, exit 3. This PR stays a draft until an APPROVED review by an authorized approver (`os-zhuang` / `hotlong`) is on it; the claiming seat lands it afterwards. Not flipped ready, no auto-merge armed.

**Line readings (a `skills/**` diff owes two).**

- `skills/objectui/guides/project-setup.md`, whole file: 350 lines before, 348 after (net −2: four rows dropped, one prose line plus its separating blank line added).
- Bundle, every `.md` under `skills/objectui/` (16 files): 4813 lines before, 4811 after. `skills/objectui/SKILL.md` alone: 142 before and after, untouched.
- Tokens: this repository declares no skills token ratchet; `pnpm check:skill-eval-tokens` is the eval-side oracle and is green below.

**Declared narrowings.**

- `pnpm test` is narrowed from the full suite to the four files above. `doc-version-claims.test.ts` is the one test that names `project-setup.md` (`git grep -l "project-setup" -- '**/__tests__/**' '**/*.test.*'` answers only it); the other three are the scripts tests that read `skills/objectui`. The full suite is CI's run.
- `pnpm lint` is narrowed to a measured zero, three pieces: ① the population is read from eslint's own config — `ESLint.calculateConfigForFile` returns undefined and `isPathIgnored` returns true for both diff paths; ② the file count — `lintFiles` over the two diff paths returns 2 results, both `File ignored because no matching configuration was supplied`, 0 errors, so 0 of the 2 diff paths are in the lint population; ③ invariance — the diff touches no eslint config and no file eslint matches, so no untouched file's verdict can move. The tree-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's run.
- `pnpm type-check` is not owed: the diff is two markdown files, no TypeScript file and no manifest.
- Deviation: `pnpm install` ran as `pnpm install --config.engine-strict=false`, because the container's Node v22.22.0 is below jsdom's engine floor.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

### 改了什么

`skills/objectui/guides/project-setup.md` 的 CLI 命令表删掉四行:`objectui studio`、`objectui lint`、`objectui test`、`objectui create plugin`。这四个命令已随 objectui#11500(PR #11508)退役,CLI 现在把它们当未知命令拒绝、退出 1、什么都不写。表后加一句:插件包用它自己的初始化器 `npm create @object-ui/plugin NAME` 搭,不经 CLI。另加一个空 frontmatter 的 changeset,声明「纯文档、不发版」。

### 为什么改

这份指南是发布给使用者的 `objectui` skill 的一部分,AI agent 搭项目时照它执行。表里教的命令 CLI 已经不认,照着做就是撞墙;其中 `create plugin` 有正确路径(`npm create @object-ui/plugin`),指南却指向了退役命令。NORTH-STAR 第 4 条把这类「教错」算作产品缺陷。

### 风险与代价(含回滚)

只动两个 markdown 文件,不动代码、不发版,本地门禁全绿。`objectui generate` 行核对过仍为真(`generate.ts` 仍派发 `plugin`),没动;四个命令名在 `skills/objectui/**` 里 grep 已归零。回滚即 revert 这一个 squash commit。受管面(`skills/**`)⇒ 本 PR 停在 draft,等 `os-zhuang` / `hotlong` 的一条 APPROVED review,之后由认领席落地。
